description: Receive-side enclosure: one OZ51x RF receiver and one Zonu TTL (IRIG-B/1PPS) receiver side by side. Same architecture as the OZ510 dual housing (front SMAs, fiber plenum with slack spool, back-panel SC/APC adapter per bay) plus a rear DE-9 signal connector replacing the bare-wire front slots. Geometry built by the shared model in parts/custom/oz510-dual-housing/.

module._comment: Identical to parts/custom/oz510-dual-housing (receiver-handed reference geometry; see the full annotations there). Both bays here are receiver-handed (mirror_x false). The TTL receiver is ASSUMED mechanically identical to the RF OZ510 receiver per the Zonu TTL OEM datasheet photos (same can/plate/SMA/header/pigtail); its bay borrows the RF RX STEP for fit checks â€” verify against a real TTL unit before fabrication.

fiber_bay._comment: Deeper than the RX+TX housing (58 vs 48) and spool front-biased (spool_setback) so the DE-9's rear shell and solder-cup wiring get clear depth at the back wall. pass_slot_width widened to 16 â€” the header harness drops through the same top-open partition slot as the fiber.

sc_adapter._comment: Same flanged SC/APC simplex adapter as the OZ510 dual housing â€” see parts/vendor/sc-apc-simplex-adapter for the part model and datasheet.

panel_connector._comment: Panel-mount DE-9 (DB9 shell size E), female, solder cup â€” replaces the bare-wire pass-through. Rectangular cutout + two jackscrew holes, back panel center between the SC ports. Dims are the industry-standard DE-9 cutout (flange 30.8 x 12.55, holes at 25.0) with clearance included â€” verify against the ordered connector before printing. rear_keepout_* reserves the shell + solder-cup + wire-bend volume inside the plenum (enforced in tests).
panel_connector.type: DE-9 female, panel mount, solder cup

notes: One housing = one RF receiver + one TTL receiver (never mixed TX/RX — see the companion oz51x-dual-tx-housing). Both bays are receiver-handed: SMA outboard-left of each bay, header on the bay's right.

SIGNALS: each module uses only pins 3/5/7/9 of its 10-pin header on the receive side (pin 1 enable is N/C on receivers, evens are N/C). Suggested DE-9 map, RX housing: 1 = +12V (both), 2 = GND (both), 3 = spare, 4 = RF Received Power Monitor, 5 = RF Received Power Alarm, 6 = spare, 7 = TTL Rx Monitor, 8 = TTL Rx Alarm, 9 = spare/second GND. Kept pin-compatible with the TX housing map so one cable/loom design serves both.

WIRING PATH: header plugs exit each module's header upward, run back over the can top (3mm clearance under the lid), drop through the bay's top-open partition slot (shared with the fiber, widened to 16), and route along the plenum wall to the DE-9 solder cups. No front-panel wiring slots on this variant.
The TTL receiver bay uses the RF OZ510 Receiver STEP as a mechanical stand-in (datasheet photos show identical mechanics). Verify a real TTL unit before committing hardware.
Fiber path, mounting scheme (2x M3 + 4 studs), SMA relief, and adapter install are identical to the OZ510 dual housing â€” see its params notes for the full history and rationale.
